text: One by one, the fighters lay down their swords, not in defeat, in recognition.
There comes, for each of them, a moment of seeing clearly.
There was never anything to defend. The light was never in danger.
Love was the answer before the question was asked.
And in that moment, the weapon simply falls from the hand,
and the one who carried it walks forward, lighter, rejoicing.
This is how the war ends, not with a final victory,
not with a triumph of one side over the other.
It ends the way every war of the spirit ends, soldier by soldier,
each laying down arms in their own hour.
There is always a new arrival willing to take up the fight,
and there is always a little later, the quiet sound of another sword being set down.
The war is over for you whenever you decide it is.
That has always been true, in every density, including the one you came from.
The path continues beyond this glade, when you are ready, walk on,
back toward your world, carrying what you own.
Nothing here asks to be worshipped.
Everything here asks only to be remembered.
